subject: [RFC PATCH 4/4] mm/zswap: move reclaim-driven writeback to a kworker

2026-09-28.patch_summary: This patch moves the reclaim-driven writeback of zswap to a kworker, improving performance by avoiding stalls in application threads or kswapd. The kworker writes back swap entries in batches of SWAP_CLUSTER_MAX while holding a reference on the memcg, and reports nothing freed until the worker runs. This change is necessary because cgroup IO controllers throttle zswap writeback, causing stalls that were observed in production workloads.
